OP-SYS-002.text: CON-SUP-137 says watchdog servicing continues during start-up but not how the window watchdog is handled before the first control cycle while the start-up checks run; SYS-SUP-015 states the observable outcome (no watchdog reset in a fault-free start-up). The servicing mechanism and window-watchdog start-up handling are needed.

OP-SYS-003.text: CON-SUP-127 states that a measured time equal to its limit is within the limit (SYS-SUP-005, and likewise SYS-SUP-092), yet requires verification margins of at least 200 µs on either side of a limit, which cannot establish behaviour at exact equality.
